description: Load styles and swatches from another InDesign file (.indd, .indt, .idml) into this document: kinds paragraph, character, object, table, cell, swatches (default all six); on_conflict keep_existing (default: a style whose name exists already is not loaded), overwrite (existing styles with the same name are replaced) or rename (imported copies get a new name). Returns results per kind {before, after, added[]} and total_added; warns when nothing new arrived. Typical use when setting up a new issue from the previous one. Swatches are loaded without a conflict strategy (existing names stay).

document_id.description: Document to act on, from list_documents or open_document. Without it the frontmost document is used. A document opened with show_window false is never the active one and must always be addressed by id.

file_path.description: Real path of an .indd, .indt or .idml file on the machine running InDesign.

kinds.description: Which kinds to import. Default: all.

on_conflict.description: What happens to a name that exists already. Default keep_existing.

name: import_styles
title: Import styles from a file
